title: The Return of Christ
definition: The Return of Christ is the promised visible, personal, glorious coming of the risen Jesus to judge evil, gather His people, and make all things right.
summary: The Return of Christ is the promised visible, personal, glorious coming of the risen Jesus to judge evil, gather His people, and make all things right.
christFocus: Jesus will return as the same Lord who ascended, and every eye will see the King who was crucified and raised.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Return of Christ places present life under the future God has promised. Christian hope is not fantasy escape but confidence that the king will come, judge evil, raise the dead, and restore creation.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. People wounded by injustice, grief, disability, and suffering need to know history is moving toward christ’s public victory.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Jesus will return as the same Lord who ascended, and every eye will see the King who was crucified and raised. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. People wounded by injustice, grief, disability, and suffering need to know history is moving toward christ’s public victory. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Wait actively through worship, holiness, mission, endurance, and hope. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
